ballots.summary: Reviewed the unpacked r3 bundle file by file (HANDOFF.md, tasks.md, architecture.md, task-dag.json, execution-contract.json, drift-lock.json, spec-baseline.json, execution-prompt.md, replan-record.json). Scope conformance verified: 39 DAG nodes with 39 serial single-node waves in a topologically valid fixed order; 118 required checks = 92 scenario checks + 16 supplemental/infra checks + 10 rework checks, matching handoff counts and acceptance_aggregation; three full journeys owned by VERIFY with construction-task scopes separated from full-journey acceptance; amendment 3 (SDD_HOME projectization with llmwiki pin 075c5b4/venv llmwiki-311 and Docker via user-visible terminal channel with receipts, sandbox EPERM honestly recorded) present in architecture.md, execution-prompt.md item 0, and tasks.md P1_1. Both r2 codex REJECT items are verifiably fixed: journey_execution.order_semantics plus V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY/V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY same-Run-before-completed wording, and replan-record after_hashes refresh consistent with drift-lock and execution-prompt digests. Boundaries are tight: sole planner/product controllers, observer cannot write phase, helper finalize forbidden, and exactly three limited-artifact edges (P2_5←P2_4, I02←P2_4, I02←P2_5) enumerated identically in task-dag dependency_readiness and execution-contract with INTEGRATED_AWAITING_REAL_QUALIFICATION status rule and no waiver at VERIFY. Security posture keeps secrets out of Git, requires real role isolation and permission negatives, and routes Docker through the visible terminal channel. Remaining weaknesses are minor and non-blocking: truncated superseded-digest prefixes in the env-capability amendment, questionable flag syntax in a few retained legacy check commands (covered by the mandated recheck of the 108 existing checks), and a not-fully-self-contained bundle with an honestly disclosed partial scripts/check.sh run. No blocking findings; I would authorize the gated next step now.

Verified the r3 bundle end to end from the tar bytes (SHA-256 matches the review digest). Every headline claim reproduces: 39 DAG nodes in 39 dependency-consistent single-task waves (fixed serial order), 118 required checks (108 retained + 10 repair, all required), 92 acceptance IDs covered bijectively by checks and the aggregation table, three journeys with execution_owner=VERIFY, amendment 3 (llmwiki projectization + Docker terminal channel with receipts and honest sandbox-EPERM disclosure), and both r2 codex fixes present and mutually consistent (journey_execution.order_semantics forbidding retrofitted recovery windows; V_RW expected defined as a fault window within the same product Run before completed, cross-referenced from V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY). All four drift-lock anchors reproduce from bundle bytes, including the plan digest under the declared checkbox-normalized-v1 mode. Ownership/allowed-path mapping is exact across all 39 nodes. Remaining weaknesses are minor bookkeeping, not architecture: the after_hashes refresh covers only the four locked artifacts (design.md diverges between replan-record.before_hashes and spec-baseline.sources with no amendment noting the change; execution-prompt.md/HANDOFF.md lack after-state entries), and the drift-lock amendment-3 wording compresses 'dag/contract 零改动' with 'contract hash 相应更新' into one record. No blocking findings; I would authorize the gated next step (implementation dispatch under this plan).
批准计划架构。已核对 tar 摘要、关键文件锁摘要、39 节点拓扑、118 项 required 检查及 92 场景映射；r2 的同 Run 故障窗口顺序和哈希问题已修正。所列后续风险均有失败保持阻断的验收条件，不阻止本轮计划交接。

findings.claim: Both r2 codex fixes are present and precisely worded in the execution contract.
findings.evidence: execution-contract.json journey_execution.order_semantics: 'V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY 是 V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY 同一产品 Run 进行中(completed 之前)注入的实际故障窗口...执行者不得先让产品 Run completed 再补拍恢复窗口'; check V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY.expected: '在 V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY 的同一产品 Run 进行中(其 completed 之前)...杀真实受管Comet'; V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY.expected cross-references '执行中须先容纳 V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY 的同Run故障窗口(见 journey_execution.order_semantics)'.

findings.claim: All four drift-lock anchors reproduce exactly from the bundle bytes, including the declared plan normalization.
findings.evidence: SHA-256 of tar-extracted bytes: architecture.md=648ec4e7..., task-dag.json=aa410a1a..., execution-contract.json=73c64d27... match drift-lock and replan-record.after_hashes; tasks.md under hash_mode checkbox-normalized-v1 (replace checked boxes '- [x]' with '- [ ]') yields exactly 56aa574b..., matching plan_sha256; execution-prompt.md documents this same normalization rule; contract.openspec.baseline_sha256 equals spec-baseline.json current bytes hash (767b5b98...).

findings.claim: All headline structural claims of the bundle verify programmatically.
findings.evidence: task-dag.json: 39 nodes, 39 single-task waves (fully serialized fixed order), every depends_on satisfied strictly earlier, wave set equals node set; execution-contract.json: 118 checks all required=true, 92 distinct acceptance IDs covered bijectively against drift-lock.acceptance_ids (92=92, no unknown/uncovered), 108 retained (106 RECHECK_OR_REPAIR_BY_OWNER + 1 EXISTS_REQUIRES... + 1 TO_IMPLEMENT_CANONICAL_RENAME) + 10 TO_IMPLEMENT repair checks = 118, no duplicate check IDs, every check task_ids ⊆ DAG nodes and every node referenced; acceptance_aggregation.scenario_required_checks covers 92 scenarios referencing only existing check IDs; drift-lock.allowed_paths_by_task covers all 39 nodes with zero owns/allowed mismatches; replan-record dependency_changes 'after' values match task-dag depends_on for P3_1/P2_4/I02/P3_2 and limited_artifact_handoffs matches contract dependency_readiness.limited_artifact_edges (3 edges, no-waiver clause).

findings.claim: The replan-record after_hashes refresh is incomplete: files that changed during the replan rounds have no recorded after-state hash, and design.md shows an unexplained divergence between the two records.
findings.evidence: replan-record.before_hashes design.md=b6fe886a... vs spec-baseline.sources design.md=bf43383f... (spec-baseline reflects current state since its tasks.md entry equals the current normalized plan hash 56aa574b...); no amendment records a design.md change. Current bundle bytes of execution-prompt.md (3f9621ce...) and HANDOFF.md (6694c85e...) also differ from before_hashes with no after_hashes entry (drift-lock.json and replan-record.json are self-referential; spec-baseline.json is anchored via contract.openspec.baseline_sha256).

findings.claim: The drift-lock amendment-3 entry contains internally compressed wording: 'dag/contract 零改动' immediately followed by 'contract hash 相应更新'.
findings.evidence: drift-lock.json amendments[env-capability-20261022].content: '...; dag/contract 零改动; 共识决议修复(r2 codex findings): journey_execution.order_semantics + V_RW 同Run窗口先行 + replan-record 哈希刷新; contract hash 相应更新'. Decipherable (env-capability made zero dag/contract changes; the consensus fix separately touched the contract), but a strict reader sees a contradiction.

findings.claim: Five owned paths are owned by two tasks each, but serialization makes this safe.
findings.evidence: docs/architecture/adr/0019-delivery-foundation.md (P0_1,P0_4), docs/agent/skill-architecture.md (P0_3,P1_6), tools/adapters/claude-code.sh and hooks.yaml (P1_2,P4_5), bin/cli.js (P2_3,P4_4); each pair is strictly ordered by the single-task waves, so no concurrent writer exists.

findings.claim: Status honesty is maintained throughout: planned-but-unexecuted items cannot be mistaken for evidence.
findings.evidence: All 10 repair checks availability=TO_IMPLEMENT with implementation_status=PLANNED_REPAIR_NOT_EXECUTED and historical_results_may_close=false; commands_status states TO_IMPLEMENT/--journey interfaces 'are planned public interfaces, not executable evidence'; HANDOFF discloses scripts/check.sh could not complete full regression on this host (os.utime read-only protection) and explicitly refuses to sign overall check pass; partially checked I01/I03 step boxes carry '基础设施未真实安装/验证保持未完成' and match replan-record 'I01/I03 config steps preserved; remaining runtime qualification still pending'.

findings.claim: Amendment 3 environment capability (llmwiki projectization + Docker terminal channel) is consistently recorded across documents with security discipline preserved.
findings.evidence: architecture.md '2026-10-22 环境能力裁决' section (SDD_HOME=<repo>/.sdd, pin 075c5b4, venv llmwiki-311, Docker daemon server 29.6.2, sandbox EPERM recorded honestly, terminal-tab channel with receipts); tasks.md Task P1_1 description sentence; execution-prompt.md controller section item 0; drift-lock amendment env-capability-20261022 with user approval quotes.

findings.claim: r2 codex finding #1 is fixed in-artifact: journey execution order semantics now require the real-Comet recovery fault window to be injected within the same product Run before its completed step, and no post-completed re-enactment is permitted.
findings.evidence: execution-contract.json journey_execution.order_semantics (line 3841) and same_run_rule (line 3838); V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY expected text (line 3663) references the same-Run window via order_semantics; V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY expected (line 3597) states the kill occurs during V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY's product Run before completed.

findings.claim: 后续补丁变更需要明确触发 Runner 镜像重新构建和角色隔离复验。
findings.evidence: task-dag.json 将 I02 排在 P4_6 之前；I02 持有 runner/image.lock.json，P4_6 持有 0003-post-archive-closeout.patch。execution-contract.json 的 V_RW_RUNNER_BUILD 要求镜像包含当前完整有序补丁。

findings.claim: r2 codex finding #2 is fixed in-artifact: replan-record after_hashes were refreshed and the refreshed digests are consistent across drift-lock.json and execution-prompt.md.
findings.evidence: replan-record.json after_hashes (lines 31-38, incl. consensus_fix_20261022 note) match drift-lock.json plan/architecture/dag/execution_contract sha256 fields (lines 5-8) and execution-prompt.md locked hashes (lines 36-39); drift-lock amendment env-capability-20261022 (lines 474-484) records the same consensus-fix scope.

findings.claim: 同 Run 故障窗口的顺序语义已修正，但两条独立旅程命令的会合协议仍须在实现时固定。
findings.evidence: execution-contract.json 的 journey_execution.order_semantics 要求 V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY 在 V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY 的 completed 前执行；两项 required check 使用独立 CLI 命令和证据目录，命令参数没有共享试验标识。

findings.claim: The env-capability-20261022 amendment records the superseded plan/architecture digests only as 8-hex prefixes, weakening byte-exact provenance of the superseded generation compared to the 64-hex digests used everywhere else.
findings.evidence: drift-lock.json lines 479-482: supersedes_hashes {"plan":"eb7ed2cb","architecture":"66ac6e36"} vs full 64-char digests in replan-record.json before_hashes and drift-lock top-level fields.

findings.claim: 当前范围尚不能保证整体目标完成，F10 仍受单独的跨机器授权条件约束；计划对此保持阻断是正确的。
findings.evidence: execution-contract.json 将 V_F10 标为 required，并声明 conditional_batch5 需要明确跨机器授权；task-dag.json 中 VERIFY 依赖 P5_2，completion_predicate 明确未验证的 F10 阻止整体完成。

findings.claim: Some retained pre-existing check commands embed flags that plain `node --test` may reject (e.g. `--scenario method-state-scope --json` appended to `node --test` invocations), risking command-level failures that must not be misread as behavior RED/FAIL.
findings.evidence: execution-contract.json V_P1_6_PONYTAIL_ASSETS command (line 3328) and V_I02_METHOD_STATE_SCOPE command (line 3386) use `node --test ... --scenario ... --json`; by contrast the 10 rework checks use valid `--test-reporter=tap`/`--test-name-pattern` forms (e.g. lines 3415, 3474). HANDOFF.md line 53 explicitly mandates re-verifying the actual commands/environments of the existing 108 checks.

findings.claim: The bundle is not fully self-contained: it cites evidence files not packaged (rework-plan-check-sh.log, handoff-validation.json, infrastructure-tasks.json, replan-history/previous) and discloses that `bash scripts/check.sh` could not run to completion on the planning host due to a read-only os.utime fixture, so plan-level validation is partial and honestly not claimed as a pass.
findings.evidence: HANDOFF.md line 95 (check.sh limitation, no waiver of V_FULL_CHECK); execution-contract.json V_INFRA_I0x checks defer oracles to infrastructure-tasks.json (e.g. lines 3066, 3105); replan-record.json history pointer (line 6).

next_action: write the conclusion and next-step plan
